anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
The remaining question is what the report view should do with active filters when the user switches workspace.

A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch, so each workspace opens unfiltered.
B) Preserve all active filters across switches, so the same filters carry into the new workspace.
C) Restore each workspace's last filters, so returning to a workspace brings back its own filters.

Recommendation: B - the workspace-change handler in ui/report-view.ts already keeps active filters. That makes B a resolver default in settings/resolver.ts:12 with no per-workspace filter state and no change for current users.
